title: Mobility options to explore
intro: Soft CTAs for established Dutch mobility options when your week runs on a personal bike. Subscription fleets deepen on the Bike sharing guide — confirm live plans on each site. This block is not a ranking of shops, locks or apps.

items.reason: Maintained subscription bike when you want predictable monthly cost before owning — deepen fleets and sharing models on the Bike sharing sibling guide.
Train travel for longer legs after a bike feed to the station — keep lock discipline at the rack before you board.
Occasional shared cars when bikes and OV are not enough for a weekend errand — keep four wheels optional.
